cards.text: SOFIA WOVEN TOTE — VEL-SOFIA-STRUCTURED-01 STORYBOARD

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: 30s one-take organic review for the Sofia Woven Tote. Angle: it won't stand up (the structured woven bag). Awareness: product aware, so she has already read the word structured on the page and does not believe it. The ad argues nothing. It concedes her doubt in the first five seconds, reverses it immediately to open the loop, names the product, stacks three physical facts, then runs ONE test on camera with both hands visibly off the bag and holds the silence while it stands. House formula throughout: hook, product intro, attribute stack, proof, capacity, variants, offer, link. Reference is a 3:04 organic handbag review whose engine is a real reservation stated up front. Shoot as one continuous handheld take, one room, no music, no cuts.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I was so disappointed when I opened this bag last night. I honestly thought the color was off
Sat on the floor of her bag room, product hidden inside a dust bag, held to chest. Persistent channel banner across the top.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Reservation — the hook. She opens with a real complaint about the bag she is reviewing. This is the entire reason it reads as a review and not an ad.

Caption card carries the thesis, not the words. Product concealed for the first 50 seconds.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: the leather needs a chance to breathe. So keep that in mind when you get your next package
Bag now out, held up by the strap, second caption card burned in.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Generosity — she hands the viewer a tip that is not about buying. Buys trust before the sell.

Only two caption cards in the whole 3:04. They mark thesis beats, never word-sync.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Now, here we are the next day, and let me show you this stunner. This is the Multipasse
Full clean look at the product for the first time, held square to lens, named.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Payoff plus product intro — the reversal resolves and the name lands on a clean frame.

We move this to 0:05. She can delay because she is an affiliate selling a category. We are the brand.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I love a top handle just for grab and go. And then lastly we have our belt buckle shoulder strap
Three carry modes demonstrated back to back: top handle, shoulder, crossbody.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Versatility — the emotional centre of the reference. DOES NOT PORT.

DOES NOT PORT. The Sofia is top handle only at roughly a 4 inch drop. This slot becomes our stand test.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: And inside, it's just literally a super simple bag. The leather on here moves beautifully
Opens the bag toward the lens, shows lining and interior.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Proof by inspection — she never says the quality is good, she shows it and lets you judge.

Demonstrate never describe. Every claim in the reference is a thing her hands do.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I'm in love, though. I might have found the one for me
Bag pushed toward the lens, laughing, cut lands on the laugh.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Exposed verdict — personal, slightly vulnerable, no pitch. Ends on her, not on an offer.

Cut ON the laugh, never after it.

cards.title: REFERENCE CREATIVE  ·  TikTok @laura_jo69 · 3:04 organic handbag review · 499 words / 163 wpm
SCRIPT
cards.text: I thought this woven tote was gonna fall apart. I was so wrong.
Sat cross legged on the floor, bag already in both hands, front square to lens, full silhouette from frame one. Mid sentence.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
HOOK — doubt and reversal back to back. The reversal at second four is what opens the loop; everything after it answers why she was wrong.

She is already mid-thought on the first word. No throat clearing. The doubt is about OUR bag only, never the category.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: This is the Sofia Woven Tote from Velantra.
Holds it still by both handles, square to lens against the plain wall, calm and flat.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
PRODUCT INTRO — recognition. Flat and plain, no selling in the voice.

Name lands on a clean static frame, never mid-rotation. This beat is never cut and never delayed.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It's hand woven, structured so it holds its shape, and there's no logo anywhere.
Camera closer, bag fills frame, one finger flat on the bare woven front below the crossed straps. Weave, braided side lacing and cream stitching in sharp detail.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
ATTRIBUTE STACK — criteria handed over. These double as what a searching buyer shops by, which is how we become the best one without comparing to anything.

No logo is a top driver for this avatar and a hard verifiable fact. It stays in every cut.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: So I'm putting in my sweater, a bottle and a book, and taking my hands off.
Bag upright on the floor in front of her crossed legs, lowering a folded cream knit sweater into the opening behind the flap. Steel bottle and paperback waiting on the floor.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
PROOF plus CAPACITY — ordinary and unstaged. Real boring objects are what make the test believable.

Props must be hers and look it. No styled objects. She names each thing as it goes in.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: [silence]
Bag stands square on the floor, packed, untouched. Both hands raised open, palms to camera, held clear on either side.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
THE PROOF FRAME — this is the whole ad. Hands visible and empty is the evidence. Hands out of frame would read as a hand propping it up.

HOLD A FULL 1.5 SECONDS WITH NOTHING SAID. The instinct will be to talk over it. Do not. Camera static, no zoom.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Look at that. It's holding all of that on its own.
Camera drops to just above floor level. Bag square and unsupported, filling frame, sides flat and top level under load. Her arms folded behind, face soft.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
PAYOFF — quiet satisfaction, not triumph. She states what is already visible rather than selling it.

Still static. The line lands after the eye has already seen it.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It comes in eight colors, they're on sale right now, and the colorways go fast.
Colorway grid. Caramel, cream, light chocolate, sky blue, lightning orange, lady pink.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
VARIANTS plus OFFER — soft and factual. Colors go, never a countdown or a stock number.

Verified 8/21: eight colorways exist, Sunny Yellow is the only one sold out, 119.99 from 149.99 is live. Re-verify on shoot day.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I left the link below.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: Screen recording of the live product page: real price, real strike-through, swatch row, Add to Cart. Clean browser, no bookmarks or extensions.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
CTA — flat, no urgency performance. The page does the closing.

Captured live at edit time. Never build a fake page or an invented graphic. The cart must show the real sale.

cards.title: OUR VERSION — VEL-SOFIA-STRUCTURED-01  ·  30s · 82 words + a 1.5s silent hold · one continuous handheld take

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: DO — the one rule that decides this ad
cards.text: Hold the 1.5 second silence at 0:17 with both hands up and empty. That beat is the entire reason to make this ad. If it looks staged or a hand is out of frame, nothing else matters.

cards.title: DO — one take, one room
cards.text: Same floor, same wardrobe, same window light, camera never moves except the drop to floor level at 0:19. No music. No cuts. If she fumbles a word, keep it.

cards.title: DON'T — no category claims
cards.text: The doubt is hers about this bag. Never say or imply that other straw bags are floppy, fragile or badly made. No other brand named or on screen. No dupe, replica or alternative language.

cards.title: DON'T — never touch the closure on camera
cards.text: Never film hands unfastening the straps or lifting the flap in motion. The flap is one continuous sheet folded all the way over and it stays that way. Closure state changes happen across a cut.

cards.title: DON'T — the bag is never 'she'
cards.text: The product is 'it'. Our bags carry women's names, so personifying the Sofia reads as an actual person. Applies to VO, captions and every note.

cards.title: OPEN DECISION for Brooks
cards.text: The 0:17 and 0:19 frames read as an EMPTY bag, because the flap correctly covers everything packed inside it. The line says it is holding all of that. Options: (a) accept, the load is established at 0:12; (b) re-roll with a sweater edge visible in the gap behind the flap, which is the exact place the first pass broke the mechanism; (c) let the sweater sleeve hang over the back edge on the shoot. My call is (a) for generation and (c) on a real shoot.

cards.title: PRODUCTION — real creator, real bag
cards.text: Every beat is hands on. The Sofia mutates within seconds of motion on Seedance and Kling, so these keyframes are for approval and blocking, not a render path. Route to Trybe or a paid creator with a real caramel Sofia.

cards.title: Keyframe provenance
cards.text: Generated GPT Image 2 i2i. All five action frames descend from the product intro frame so room, wardrobe, light and identity stay locked across the take, and the bag is driven off the canonical Sofia reference. First pass was rejected for six different rooms and contents riding over the flap; it is archived, not deleted.
